predictions.statement: Android CPU and PC CPU outputs may differ byte-for-byte but should pass the frozen numerical tolerance.
XNNPACK cannot own the complete graph because the official supported-op list covers Conv but does not list Clip or DepthToSpace; a hybrid path may still accelerate Conv partitions.
NNAPI partition coverage on this firmware remains unknown until the profile is parsed.

acceptance: Every successful run saves an immutable float32 little-endian output artifact referenced by bytes and SHA-256 in its receipt.
Every successful run saves an ORT profile referenced by bytes and SHA-256 in its receipt.
The host comparator verifies receipt, raw-output hash, element count, finite values, tolerance and mismatch denominator.
The profile parser reports provider counts and node names without promoting requested-provider configuration into an assignment claim.
Strict failures remain preserved; hybrid success is not reported as full-provider coverage.
stopRules: Do not call hash inequality a correctness failure before numerical comparison.
Do not call a hybrid run XNNPACK-only or NNAPI-only.
Do not change the model merely to obtain a green provider result before profiling the locked graph.
Do not extrapolate the 64x64 tensor probe to video throughput.
